title: Presolving renders problem infeasible
body:
While debugging my own application, I encountered a problem that appears to be related to SCIP presolving. Presolve appears to render this non-linear problem [debug_problem.cip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/25315740/debug_problem.cip.txt) infeasible:

With 3 rounds of presolving
```
scip -c "read debug_problem.cip set presolving maxrounds 3 optimize quit"
```
